roasting_manifesto.title: From Karnataka Western Ghats to Pune Cups in Fresh Small Batches.
roasting_manifesto.subtitle: We source single-origin specialty Arabica directly from heritage coffee estates in Chikmagalur, Coorg, and Biligirirangana Hills. Never stale, never bitter.
body_paragraphs: Most commercial coffees sit in plastic warehouse packaging for months before reaching your cup. At Deccan Coffee Roasters, we source green beans directly from shade-grown estates in the Western Ghats of Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

We roast in small batches right here in Pune. By controlling temperature and airflow minute by minute, we bring out the bean's natural notes of toasted hazelnuts, dark cocoa, and sugarcane jaggery without bitter char.

methods.name: Hario V60 Pourover
methods.description: Conical dripper with spiral ribs. Delivers high clarity, vibrant sweetness, and delicate floral notes.

steps.tip: Pour 3x coffee weight in water. Let coffee bloom and release natural CO2 gases.
Pour in slow concentric circles starting from the center outward.
Pour remainder of water steadily. Give dripper one gentle swirl.
Allow bed to drain flat. Swirl carafe and pour into cups.

methods.name: Classic Chemex
methods.description: Heavy bonded filter paper removes sediment and oils, creating an exceptionally clean and smooth cup.

steps.tip: Wet coffee bed evenly with 18% water, allow bubbling to crest.
Pour steadily in circles, keeping water level below wood collar.
Bring water to final scale weight with gentle circular pouring.
Discard filter cone. Swirl glass carafe before serving.

methods.name: AeroPress (Inverted)
methods.description: Air-pressurized immersion yields concentrated body, high sweetness, and low bitterness in 2 minutes.

steps.tip: Set inverted position, add grounds, pour 100% water in 20 seconds.
Stir 5 times gently for uniform contact.
Rinse paper filter, screw cap on, let coffee steep.
Carefully flip onto cup and press plunger down gently for 30 seconds.

methods.name: Classic French Press
methods.description: Direct immersion extracts natural coffee oils, delivering rich mouthfeel and dark chocolate depth.

steps.tip: Pour all heated water vigorously over coarse coffee grounds.
Place plunger lid on top without pressing down yet. Allow grounds to brew.
Break top crust with a spoon and skim away floating foam.
Press mesh filter down smoothly and pour into cups immediately.

tips: Use clean, filtered water for the best flavor clarity.
Rinse paper filters with hot water first to remove paper taste.
Store whole coffee beans in an airtight container away from direct sunlight.

testimonials.title: Loved by Pune Coffee Enthusiasts
testimonials.subtitle: What daily visitors, remote workers, and specialty coffee lovers say about our coffee.

reviews.author: Rahul Kulkarni
reviews.quote: Hands down the best flat white in Pune. The Chikmagalur Kallathigiri lot has rich chocolate notes with zero bitterness. Their sourdough toast and cardamom buns are exceptional.

reviews.author: Sneha Patil
reviews.quote: Such a peaceful spot to sit with a book or get work done. High ceilings, polite baristas who actually know their coffee origins, and fast Wi-Fi. A gem in Pune.

reviews.author: Amit Joshi
reviews.quote: I buy my whole beans from here every two weeks. The roast date is always fresh within 4-5 days. Their cold drip over ice is my go-to during warm Pune afternoons.

reviews.author: Tanvi Rao
reviews.quote: Deccan Coffee Roasters sets a real quality standard for specialty coffee in Pune. Clean aesthetic, friendly vibe, and authentic estate-sourced Indian coffees.
